description: Hand-labelled DROP. Despite the clickbait headline ('Is Mark Zuckerberg a robot?'), the body is a rant restating already-known events (Meta's robotics push, Llama, the $65B spend) with no forecast, thesis, or non-obvious claim — commentary-as-venting, not analysis. Contrast case to opinion-ai-robot-race-keep.json: same general subject, different verdict based on body content.
